Hi Sara and Acme team,

Thanks for partnering with Redwood Inference. I'm Olga on the vendor operations team — I'll be your primary contact for onboarding and PO setup. Attached is our standard onboarding checklist (RI_Onboarding_Checklist_v1.xlsx) to speed things up. To get your account ready for PO issuance and first invoice, please review the "What we need from you" column and return the requested items: 

- Completed vendor questionnaire (PDF or spreadsheet)
- Signed W9 or local tax form (we received your W9 placeholder but need the signed copy)
- Billing contact name, email, and remit-to address
- Preferred PO number format (example: ACME-12345)
- Sample invoice (optional, helps mapping)

What we'll provide back to you (what you can expect from Redwood):
- Vendor profile and vendor ID in our procurement system
- PO routing instructions and billing email for invoices (billing@redwood.ai)
- Link to our vendor portal and initial SSO invite

Next steps / suggested timeline:
1) You: Return the completed questionnaire + signed W9 by end of next week (Nov 19)
2) We: Create vendor record and confirm PO template within 2 business days of receiving docs
3) Kickoff call: propose Tue Nov 16 10:00 AM PST (30 min) — confirm if that works for you

I've also created a shared folder for document exchange: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeFgHIjkl_onboarding (view only for now).

If you prefer, we can capture the above as a short mutual action register during the call. Let me know if anyone else at Acme should be looped in.

Thanks,
